name: @cerebro/desktop
description: Cerebro desktop app: Tauri v2 shell (src-tauri) and SolidJS UI (ui). The UI also runs in a plain browser against the typed mock service (web mode) for headless testing.

scripts.build: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs ui/dist
scripts.build:desktop: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts --mode desktop && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs ui/dist-desktop
scripts.test: npm run check && vitest run --config ui/vite.config.ts && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.tauri:check: npm run build:desktop && cargo check -p cerebro-desktop --locked
